cap: Sort a testicular tumor first by its cell of origin, then by its marker. About 95 percent are germ cell tumors: seminoma never makes AFP, yolk sac tumor makes AFP, and choriocarcinoma makes very high hCG. Sex cord-stromal tumors make hormones instead of markers, and lymphoma is the most common testicular mass after age 60.
teach: Markers are drawn before and after radical inguinal orchiectomy. A marker that falls more slowly than expected after surgery signals residual or metastatic disease. LDH reflects tumor bulk and helps staging but does not name the tumor type.
